title: Loomward v0.3 view-model service contract
description: Every request, response, result payload and streamed event of the v0.3 view-model service (docs/41-v03-architecture.md section 5). Command-to-payload bindings live in contracts/v3/commands.json. Status: proposed (docs/42 ADR-V3-03). A schema match is never permission: the service re-validates scope, grants and bounds. No definition here describes a file or process effect; every effect capability is the constant false.

NodeId.$comment: Opaque, session-tagged. Identifies a catalogue row for viewing only; never an effect operand (invariant 5).

ProcessRef.$comment: Encodes pid plus process start time so PID reuse cannot alias. Observation only.

Cursor.$comment: Opaque; bound to command, query, anchor, generation and session. Not reusable for another scope.

ByteCount.$comment: Exact unsigned decimal. All byte quantities on the wire use this, never JSON numbers (ADR-V3-04). Range 0..18446744073709551615 (u64::MAX) is enforced at runtime (semantics.md section 9); the pattern alone admits larger 20-digit strings.

NullableBytes.$comment: null means unknown, never zero (invariant 4). Same runtime range as ByteCount.

NullableRate.$comment: Display-only per-second rate; null until two samples exist.

Timestamp.$comment: RFC 3339 in UTC with a literal Z; display and chronology only. Servers emit millisecond precision.

StreamEpoch.$comment: Random per service start; event seq is only comparable within one epoch (semantics.md section 7).

Tier.$comment: 0 is fastest, 9 slowest; demotion goes to an equal or higher number (planner v1/v2 rule).

DatasetClass.$comment: One catalogue file per class; a session serves exactly one (ADR-V3-15).

EnumerationStrategy.$comment: Default pending the LW-101 spike: file_id_extd_directory_info (ADR-V3-05).

DisplayPath.$comment: Display only. Never accepted back as input; no command takes a path string.

payload.$comment: Validated against the request definition named for this command in commands.json.

expected_state_rev.$comment: Revision precondition for owner-state mutations (volumes.declare_tier, collections.update_members): the call commits only while state.db is still at this revision, else stale_generation with detail.reason state_rev_changed (semantics.md sections 3 and 5). Elsewhere invalid_request.

catalog_rev.$comment: Catalogue revision the response was read at, or committed at for a mutation (semantics.md section 5).

state_rev.$comment: state.db revision the response was read at, or committed at for a mutation; null when the command touched no state.db data (semantics.md section 5).

catalog_rev.$comment: Emitted only after the change it describes is committed (semantics.md section 6).

state_rev.$comment: state.db revision of the commit the event describes; null for events about catalogue-only changes or telemetry.

data.$comment: Validated against the event definition named in commands.json; L1 generates discriminated envelope validation from commands.json (semantics.md section 10).

diagnostics_save.$comment: The desktop adapter's Rust-side save dialog for diagnostics.save (docs/42 ADR-V3-24).

federated_search.$comment: The engine honours the federated search extension of search.query (docs/46 section 4, F1): sources, terms, extensions, collection_id, under_node_id and the per-hit source, freshness and score. False: search.query serves the v1 fields only and answers any extension field with capability_unavailable.

logical_bytes.$comment: Bytes by directory entry: sum of default-stream end-of-file as listed. A hard-linked object counts once per observed name.

allocated_bytes.$comment: Bytes by directory entry: sum of default-stream allocation as listed.

stream_coverage.$comment: Alternate data streams and filesystem metadata are not observed in v0.3.

unique_objects.$comment: Distinct (volume_key, file_id) objects within this subtree; null when any entry lacks a native ID.

unique_allocated_bytes.$comment: Allocation counted once per unique object within this subtree; null when unique_objects is null or allocation is unknown.

multi_link_entries.$comment: Entries whose object has another observed name anywhere in the dataset or an observed link count above 1.

RootGrantRequest.$comment: Tauri adapter only. Rust opens the native folder picker; the webview never supplies a path.

purge_catalog.$comment: Deletes Loomward's own catalogue rows for the root. Never touches the scanned files.

RootForgetRequest.$comment: Loomward's own state only: the scanned files are never touched. Applies to a revoked root; an active one is refused.

DeviceHint.$comment: A hint about the device, not a measured speed (docs/07).

DeclareTierRequest.$comment: Records a human preference. null clears the declaration.

JobKind.$comment: placement.simulate is synchronous and bounded, never a job (semantics.md section 2).

suggestion.$comment: Optional on tree projections; lazy student threads carry ranked relative scores, abstention and reasons. Never a probability or action approval.

MeaningThread.$comment: What the owner or a model thinks this is. A suggestion is not an approval (invariant 3).

PermissionThread.$comment: What Loomward may observe. In v0.3 no thread state ever implies an effect permission.

parent.$comment: Index into TreeSlice.nodes; null only for the anchor at index 0. Parents always precede children.

size_bytes.$comment: Size under the requested basis. Under allocated basis, entries with unknown allocation contribute 0 here and are counted in size_unknown_files.

folded_count.$comment: Only for kind=other: how many siblings were folded into this node.

live.$comment: True while a scan is still adding to this subtree.

aggregate_state.$comment: consistent: every directory sum was published at a revision covering its committed listings. provisional_live: sums come from the running scan's arena snapshot; 'other' nodes are clamped at zero. Inconsistent committed sums are repaired before serving, never sent.

location_hint.$comment: Search and collection results only: the parent's display path.

sort.$comment: size_desc is index-backed for both bases (ties broken by row id). name_asc and modified_desc are served only for directories with at most 10,000 direct children; larger ones return resource_budget with detail sort_requires_index.

quality.$comment: Width is preserved: a 64-bit ID is never padded and reported as 128-bit. unverified: listed on a FAT, exFAT or unknown filesystem under an identity-unverified grant; metadata only, never an effect, placement or content-read input.

durable_reference.$comment: Whether labels and collection membership may bind to this object (docs/41 section 6.3). Without it, feedback.record returns capability_unavailable.

Suggestion.$comment: Scores are uncalibrated relative scores, not probabilities (invariant 4).

SearchRequest.$comment: Owner-local and grant-scoped (LW-113): only active grants are searched. An empty text lists by filters only. Both size and time bounds are inclusive; an entry without a modified time never matches a time bound.

sources.$comment: Federated extension (docs/46 section 4, F1); absent means [own]. Only an engine advertising features.federated_search honours the fields from here on; every other engine answers them with capability_unavailable.

terms.$comment: Structured name terms (the parsed query grammar). Every term narrows, together with text.

extensions.$comment: Extension set, lower case, no leading dot. Narrows together with extension.

under_node_id.$comment: Only entries below this directory node. Browse identity; never an operand.

SearchSource.$comment: own: the catalogue name index; everything: the optional Everything adapter (docs/46 section 5.3); semantic: the derived embedding index (section 6).

mode.$comment: token: the text starts a word of the name; substring: it occurs anywhere in the name.

negated.$comment: True: names matching the term are excluded.

state.$comment: docs/46 section 7: live (watched now), caught_up (journal catch-up at at), stale (since at), everything_live (Everything's own journal, not yet verified), verified (checked natively at at), semantic_stale (the name changed after embedding).

at.$comment: Required for caught_up, stale and verified; null for the other states.

SearchUnverifiedHit.$comment: A hit from an adapter that is not yet a catalogue row (docs/46 section 5.3): display only, and deliberately without a node_id. Native verification mints one; until then no command accepts this hit.

path.$comment: Root-relative path under a granted root, display only.

index_state.$comment: building: a searched root is being scanned; stale: a searched root is stale or failed. The index itself follows every catalogue commit.

partial.$comment: A searched root does not have complete coverage: no hit is not proof of absence.

substring_searched.$comment: False for texts too short for a trigram (or with a word under three characters): only whole names, name starts and word starts were searched.

unverified_hits.$comment: Federated extension: hits that are not yet catalogue rows, kept apart from hits. Omitted when features.federated_search is false.

path.$comment: Root-relative path of the hit itself, display only.

freshness.$comment: Federated extension: how fresh this hit's root is (docs/46 section 7).

score.$comment: Federated extension: a relative rank signal in 0..1, never a probability and not comparable across sources.

highlights.$comment: Half-open UTF-16 offsets into row.name; best effort and may be empty.

FeedbackRequest.$comment: label is null only when retract is true (service-enforced); the service stores the withdrawn label internally (docs/41 section 9.1). client_event_id is a durable idempotency key: identical replay returns the original result, reuse with different content is invalid_request. Records a human label; never a grant.

gate.description: A learning gate in force, or null. Null in both dataset classes since q-11 opened local personal learning; the teacher's personal refusal is the separate teacher_personal_gated.

idempotent_replay.$comment: True when client_event_id matched an already committed identical event; nothing new was written.

Collection.$comment: Virtual membership in Loomward's own database. Never moves, links or renames a file.

remove_members.$comment: Optional stable member IDs to remove from this collection, including unresolved members. Omission means an empty set.

TeacherRecipient.$comment: The only v0.3 teacher: GPT-6.1 Sol at medium effort via the owner's local Codex CLI. A cloud recipient.

runner_profile_digest.$comment: Pinned Codex executable hash, version, argv and effective configuration overrides (docs/41 section 9.2).

handle.$comment: Request-local handle; catalogue IDs never leave the machine.

payload_digest.$comment: SHA-256 over the canonical serialization of the complete request: instructions, allowed labels, output schema, items and serialization version.

TeacherPreview.$comment: Immutable once created. Shows the complete request that would leave the machine. Creating a preview sends nothing.

DisclosureSummary.$comment: Built by Rust from the stored immutable preview, never from UI input, and rendered by the native confirmation dialog item by item. Not sent over the wire; defined here so the Rust and dialog implementations agree.

DisclosureGrantRequest.$comment: Personal dataset: the Tauri adapter shows a native confirmation dialog from Rust; the HTTP adapter refuses. Synthetic dataset: granted by policy.

used.$comment: Single use: one grant authorises exactly one teacher request with exactly the previewed payload.

forgotten_at.$comment: Set once the owner forgot the revoked root: only this anonymised record remains.

TeacherRunRequest.$comment: Sends exactly the payload bound to the grant's digest. No node list is accepted here.

HeatBasis.$comment: mtime_proxy is a labelled what-if only; modification age is not access heat.

source_bytes.$comment: Bytes by directory entry under estimate_basis (observation, not relief).

destination_bytes.$comment: Labelled estimate: per-file logical size rounded up to the destination cluster size where known.

estimated_relief_bytes.$comment: null unless relief_basis is verified_unique_allocation or an entry_allocation_whatif was requested.

relief_basis.$comment: verified_unique_allocation: every entry has a native ID, every object's names are inside this group and link counts were observed; default stream only.

GroupOverride.$comment: Owner what-if assumptions, recorded as assumed in the plan. They never change capacities or volumes; those come from observations only.

relief_policy.$comment: verified_only (default) pre-rejects groups whose relief is unknown; entry_allocation_whatif feeds entry allocation as an assumed relief and records it in assumptions.

rejected.$comment: Exactly the planner's own rejections (parity with planner_v2).

pre_rejected.$comment: Service-level exclusions applied before the planner runs; these groups never reach it.

PlacementPlan.$comment: Field-for-field the planner_v2 output (python/loomward/planner_v2.py) with bytes as decimal strings, plus heat_policy, assumptions, root_generations and proposal_id.

subscription_id.$comment: null creates; an existing id renews and may change channels/interval.

expires_at.$comment: 60 s lease; the sampler stops when no live subscription remains.

dedicated_used_bytes.$comment: Global, from the GPU Adapter Memory counter; never a sum of per-process values.

shared_used_bytes.$comment: Global, from the GPU Adapter Memory counter.

engine_busy_fraction.$comment: Maximum over engine types of the per-type utilisation summed across that adapter's engine instances, clamped to 1 (the Task Manager method).

queue_length.$comment: PhysicalDisk Avg. Disk Queue Length; a separate quantity from busy_fraction.

cpu_fraction.$comment: Machine-normalised: CPU time over the interval divided by (interval x logical CPUs).

observed_at.$comment: Process enumeration time, independent of the containing system sample; retained rows keep this time.

working_set_bytes.$comment: Total working set, including shared pages.

cpu_fraction.$comment: Machine-normalised over the interval between process enumerations (row observed_at), not the containing system sample interval; null on the first process sample.

gpu_dedicated_bytes.$comment: GPU Process Memory dedicated usage for this process; may include shared allocations, so rows are never summed into an adapter total.

ProcessRow.$comment: No command line, no environment, no window titles (privacy).

elapsed_ms.$comment: Monotonic time since the previous sample; null on the first sample.

BudgetSetRequest.$comment: Caps Loomward's own in-process pools only. No OS priority, affinity or memory call is made.

dropped.$comment: null when unknown (epoch change or replay gap).

BackupLabel.$comment: Owner-chosen repository label. The charset keeps a URL, path or credential from ever being stored or echoed as one.

relative_name.$comment: A scope-projected manifest name, compared lexically and refused when it is absolute, traverses, uses a backslash or is Windows-ambiguous. Never resolved, opened or joined to a root.

BackupTopologyBasis.$comment: From volumes.list identity, never from text. Different volumes stay topology unknown until a physical device identity exists.

ProposedRestoreDrill.$comment: A restore drill as data only. Nothing creates, opens, writes or restores its target; no command executes it.

snapshot_time.$comment: The provider's own time text, uninterpreted; never the age oracle.

reported_recovery_evidence.$comment: Every predicate holds on the supplied, scoped evidence. Caller-reported self-consistency: never native proof, permission or a source-retirement gate.

BackupEvidence.$comment: Normalised restic receipt evidence. Snapshot, integrity and restore drill are separate observations; a green backup job is not verified recovery.

integrity_check.$comment: Also open the dialog a second time for a restic check --json output.

BackupImportRequest.$comment: Tauri adapter only. Rust opens the native open-file dialog and reads at most 256 KiB; the webview never supplies a path.

BackupForgetResult.$comment: Removes Loomward's own record only; never touches a backup or a file.

UnknownReason.$comment: A fixed snake_case token chosen by the service; never input, a path or an OS message.

DiagnosticUnknown.$comment: A value the bundle could not read: visible, never omitted and never zero (invariant 4).

DiagnosticsFilesystem.$comment: The filesystem family, never the volume name, label or serial.

DiagnosticsRoot.$comment: Keyed only by the opaque root ID: no path, name or volume label.

host.$comment: Owner decision q-16 allows host hardware in new evidence; the bundle keeps it to these.

anyOf.$comment: health.get without messages: warning codes only.
Counts only: never a collection name, a label or a receipt.
Counted over the newest window jobs the engine lists.

DiagnosticsBundle.$comment: An allowlist by construction (docs/42 ADR-V3-24): no path, file or folder name, volume label or serial, process name or argument, label text, collection name, receipt or message.

bytes.$comment: Length of the exact UTF-8 serialisation diagnostics.save writes.

DiagnosticsSaveRequest.$comment: Tauri adapter only. The digest of the preview the owner saw; Rust opens the native save dialog and the webview never supplies a path.

DiagnosticsSaveResult.$comment: Never the chosen path: it stays in Rust.

notifications_enabled.$comment: Off until the owner enables it; gates local OS notifications only. The in-app list is always available.

AlertSettings.$comment: Low free space when free < max(capacity x low_space_free_percent, low_space_free_bytes). Fast growth when a granted root's net logical growth between the oldest and newest complete scans inside growth_window_days reaches growth_bytes. alerts.configure replaces the whole record.

AlertStatus.$comment: alert is the only active alert. unknown (capacity, free space or volume not observed), insufficient_history (fewer than two complete scans in the window) and incomplete_coverage (partial scans are not comparable) say why none was raised; none reads as zero.

measured_bytes.$comment: Free bytes (low_space) or net growth (fast_growth); null is unknown.

AlertReport.$comment: Advice only, evaluated on demand from the volume space observation and the catalogue's completed scan history; no file or process effect.

CopyRefusalCode.$comment: docs/47 section 7. Codes with a P or S entry are refused before any write handle exists.

CopyPreviewRequest.$comment: Node IDs select what the engine observes afresh; the approval binds the digest of the observed native identities, never a node ID (invariant 5). The destination is a folder under an active grant; v1 creates exactly one new folder inside it and never writes into an existing folder (docs/47 section 1, Q3).

CopyPreview.$comment: Built without any effect. state is draft (approvable) or refused (deselect and preview again). The digest covers membership, destination (grant, parent identity, new folder name), bytes and identities.

CopyConsentRequest.$comment: The digest the owner saw. approve binds a single-use approval to it; start is refused unless an unexpired approval matches the digest of a manifest rebuilt from fresh observations exactly (digest_mismatch, source_changed, approval_expired, grant_revoked).

staging_folder.$comment: docs/47 Q1 default: the name (never a path) of the staging folder Loomward left in the destination parent on cancel or abandon, for the owner to remove; null otherwise.

leftover_staging_folders.$comment: Names (never paths) of staging folders that were intended but never identity-journaled (a crash between intent and identity): possibly empty leftovers Loomward never adopts or removes; reported for the owner (docs/47 section 5).
